newsitem.title: USA: INTERVIEW- Asahi/America backs Q4 estimates.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW- Asahi/America backs Q4 estimates.

text.p: Asahi/America Inc, a distributor and maker of thermoplastic valves, piping systems and components, said on Monday it expects to report 1996 earnings in line with Wall Street estimates.
"We are comfortable with the Street's estimates for sales and earnings," Leslie Lewis, chairman, president and chief exeuctive, said in a telephone interview.
Lewis cited an estimate of $0.77 a share for 1996, and said he sees sales of $38.5 million to $38.7 million for the year.
"We look strong for the fourth quarter," he said.

For the first nine months of 1996, Asahi/America earned $0.61 a share, compared to $0.45 a share for the first nine months of 1995. The company earned $0.68 a share on sales of $35.0 million for the 1995 year.
Last May, the Boston-based company held an initial public offering of 1.16 million shares of common stock at $7.50 a share. Asahi/America closed Friday at $8 a share.
